description_en: Dissociates the web tamper-proofing protected directory from a specified server
description_zh: 解除指定服务器的网页防篡改防护目录
name: ModifyWebLockUnbind

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the server from which you want to dissociate the protected directory.
You can call the [DescribeWebLockBindList](~~DescribeWebLockBindList~~) operation to retrieve the UUID of the server
parameters.help_zh:
指定需要解绑防护目录的服务器的UUID。
您可以调用[DescribeWebLockBindList](~~DescribeWebLockBindList~~)接口获取服务器的UUID
parameters.name: uuid

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
